name: web-industrial-home-page-on-tilted-tablet-in-hand
title: Metal-supplier homepage on a tablet tilted in a hand against neutral grey
whatItIs: A hand holds a tablet at a steep angle in front of a mid-grey rounded panel; the screen shows a blue hero with steel bars, promo tiles for discounts, returns and delivery, and a category list.
whatItMeans: Practical and confident; the tilt gives dynamism to a plain catalogue.
techniques: Tilt the device sharply for energy.
Show hero banner plus promo tiles.
Let the hand overlap the bottom edge.

vocabulary.definition: A device angled strongly in frame.
A small banner for an offer.
A vertical menu of product groups.
